positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (2.3): 0 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 0 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 19). Context, not scored: resales in 0% of months (24 months).

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: The first resale wave ended before the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity. First resale wave from Oct 2023 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date).

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Orchard MRT about 450 m, Newton MRT about 640 m; closer than 243 of 551 similar developments (the same as 10). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest Anglo-Chinese School (Junior) about 610 m; more than 107 of 551 similar developments (the same as 202). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 9 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 320 m), more than 419 of 551 similar developments (the same as 42); nearest hawker centre Newton Food Centre about 690 m; nearest park Istana Park about 1,080 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 1,100 m; 21 Anderson, 6 new sales, about 1,120 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 1,190 m; Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 1,200 m; Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 1,220 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 1,240 m; Hill House, 5 new sales, about 1,320 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 1,370 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 485 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,372 new sales and 1,363 resales (2,735 purchases); new sales were 50.2% of these purchases. Subsales (58) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 480 m; Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 720 m; upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,160 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,363 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 533 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,363 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,482 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−8%). Planning-area private resales +16%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
